content.json:
## Amador visitors

Visitor statistics for amadoram.com from Azure Application Insights. **Everything is recorded and labeled**, except browsers the team has opted out with amadoram.com/?noanalytics=1, which send nothing to Azure. Use the filters to see people only (the default) or bots and automated traffic too. Traffic types use the codes shared with Juricio's statistics: persona (person), bot, automatizado (automated) and interno (internal). Pages are route templates, never the full address, query or page title. Browsers that send Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control are not recorded.
Visitors, sessions and page views for the period, with the filters above.

content.query:
let types = dynamic([{TipoTrafico}]);
let environments = dynamic([{Ambiente}]);
let include_unseen = {NoVistas};
let base = pageViews
| extend traffic_type = tostring(customDimensions.tipo_trafico), reason = tostring(customDimensions.motivo),
    bot_name = tostring(customDimensions.bot_nombre), environment = tostring(customDimensions.ambiente),
    visibility = tostring(customDimensions.visibilidad), known_route = tostring(customDimensions.ruta_conocida)
| where traffic_type in (types) and environment in (environments)
| where include_unseen or visibility == "visible";
base
| summarize visitors = dcount(user_Id), views = count()
    by country = client_CountryOrRegion, region = client_StateOrProvince, city = client_City
| order by visitors desc
| take 50
content.title: Cities
content.noDataMessage: No data for these filters and this period.

content.query:
let types = dynamic([{TipoTrafico}]);

content.json: Which sites visitors arrive from: only the referrer's domain, never its path or query. Arrivals by source count the first page of each session: AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, Gemini), search engines (Google, Bing), direct and other sites. The utm_source parameter does not reach Azure (the browser drops the query), so a visit from an AI app that sends no referrer counts as "(direct)".

content.query:
let types = dynamic([{TipoTrafico}]);
let environments = dynamic([{Ambiente}]);
let include_unseen = {NoVistas};
let base = pageViews
| extend traffic_type = tostring(customDimensions.tipo_trafico), reason = tostring(customDimensions.motivo),
    bot_name = tostring(customDimensions.bot_nombre), environment = tostring(customDimensions.ambiente),
    visibility = tostring(customDimensions.visibilidad), known_route = tostring(customDimensions.ruta_conocida)
| where traffic_type in (types) and environment in (environments)
| where include_unseen or visibility == "visible";
base
| extend referrer = tostring(customDimensions.refUri)
| where referrer != cloud_RoleInstance
| extend referrer = iff(isempty(referrer), "(direct)", referrer)
| summarize visits = count(), visitors = dcount(user_Id) by referrer
| order by visits desc
| take 50
content.title: Referring sites (referrer domain only)
content.noDataMessage: No data for these filters and this period.

content.query:
let types = dynamic([{TipoTrafico}]);
let environments = dynamic([{Ambiente}]);
let include_unseen = {NoVistas};
let base = pageViews
| extend traffic_type = tostring(customDimensions.tipo_trafico), reason = tostring(customDimensions.motivo),
    bot_name = tostring(customDimensions.bot_nombre), environment = tostring(customDimensions.ambiente),
    visibility = tostring(customDimensions.visibilidad), known_route = tostring(customDimensions.ruta_conocida)
| where traffic_type in (types) and environment in (environments)
| where include_unseen or visibility == "visible";
base
| extend referrer = tostring(customDimensions.refUri), own_host = cloud_RoleInstance
| summarize arg_min(timestamp, referrer, own_host, user_Id) by session_Id
| extend source = case(
    referrer in ("chatgpt.com", "chat.openai.com"), "ChatGPT",
    referrer in ("perplexity.ai", "www.perplexity.ai"), "Perplexity",
    referrer == "claude.ai", "Claude",
    referrer in ("copilot.microsoft.com", "copilot.cloud.microsoft"), "Copilot",
    referrer == "gemini.google.com", "Gemini",
    referrer matches regex @"^(www\.)?google(\.[a-z]{2,3}){1,2}$", "Google",
    referrer in ("bing.com", "www.bing.com"), "Bing",
    isempty(referrer), "(direct)",
    referrer == own_host, "(this site)",
    "other sites")
| extend source_group = case(source in ("ChatGPT", "Perplexity", "Claude", "Copilot", "Gemini"), "AI assistant",
    source in ("Google", "Bing"), "search engine", "other")
| summarize sessions = count(), visitors = dcount(user_Id) by source_group, source
| order by source_group asc, sessions desc
content.title: Arrivals by source: AI assistants, search engines, direct and other sites (first page of each session)
content.noDataMessage: No data for these filters and this period.
